components.note: 讠 (speech) — words and language, as in 说, 请, 谢; 记 is to note down or remember.
己 (jǐ) is a close sound clue for jì; 己 also sounds out 纪 jì and 起 qǐ.
戈 (halberd) — a weapon guarding a place 口: 或 first meant a defended territory (域 yù adds 土). "Perhaps, or" is a later use.
者 (zhě) is a sound clue for 都 dū, 著 zhù, 煮 zhǔ, 猪 zhū and 诸 zhū; as a word it means "one who", as in 作者 author.
扌 (hand) — hand actions, as in 打, 拿, 抱; 担 is to carry on the shoulder, then to bear a duty.
旦 (dàn) is a close sound clue for dān; 旦 also sounds out 但 dàn and 胆 dǎn.
心 (heart) — a picture of a heart. Written 忄 on the left (快, 怕) and 心 at the bottom (想, 思, 忘); it marks feelings and thoughts.
纟 (silk thread, simplified 糸) — threads and connections, as in 红, 给, 经, 系; 继 is to keep a thread going.
纟 (silk thread, simplified 糸) — threads and connections, as in 红, 给, 经, 继; a thread that goes on.
卖 stands in for 賣 in 續, only a loose sound clue for xù.
亲 (qīn) keeps the sound part of the traditional 親, which also had 见; it also gives 新 xīn and 薪 xīn, so qīn/xīn is a series.
友 (friend) replaces the heart-and-foot lower part of the traditional 愛, which had 心 (heart); so 爱 lost its heart in simplification.
父 (father) — a hand holding a stone axe, an image of the household head who works and rules.
羊 (sheep) — traditionally 羊 over 大: a big, fat sheep was good, tasty and pleasing, hence beautiful. 羊 also appears in 样 and 洋.
囗 (enclosure) — borders and walls, as in 园 garden, 圆 round, 回 return; 囗 is the country's boundary.
玉 (jade) — treasure within the border; the traditional 國 had 或 (defended territory) inside.
宀 (roof) — houses and shelter, as in 家, 安, 室; 完 first meant complete, whole.
元 (yuán) is a close sound clue for wán; 元 also sounds out 玩 wán, 院 yuàn and 远 yuǎn.
玉 (jade) — jade put away safely: 全 first meant flawless, pure, then whole.
宀 (roof) — houses and shelter, as in 家, 安, 室.
玉 (jade) — jade kept under a roof: treasure. The traditional 寶 also had 贝 (cowrie, money).
贝 (cowrie) — a shell, once used as money. As a radical it marks money and value: 财 wealth, 货 goods, 买 buy, 费 cost.
世 (generation) — from 卅 (thirty): about thirty years is one generation, so an age or the world.
田 (field) — fields have boundaries, which is what 界 means.
介 (jiè) gives the exact sound; 介 also sounds out 价 jià.
小 (small) — three small dots, tiny grains. As a radical it appears in 少 few, 尖 sharp.
重 (zhòng) is a sound clue for 种 zhǒng/zhòng; it means heavy (zhòng) or to repeat (chóng, as in 重新).
刂 (knife) — cutting, as in 到, 分, 刻; to cut apart means separate.
另 (lìng, other) — separating things into "other" parts: 别 is another, different, or "don't".
田 (field) — a field above 力 (strength): a man is one who works the fields with strength.
木 (tree) — wood, as in 树, 林, 桌; the older meaning was a wooden mechanism.
几 (jī) gives the exact sound; also in 饥 jī and 肌 jī.
会 (meet, can) — simplified from 會, a lid on a container: bringing things together; hence meeting, then "can" (huì).
见 (see) — a big eye on a person's legs 儿: a person looking. The same 见 is in 现 appear, 觉 sense, 视 look.
扌 (hand) — hand actions, as in 拿, 抱, 把; 打 is to hit.
丁 (dīng) is a loose sound clue for dǎ; 丁 also sounds out 订 dìng, 顶 dǐng and 钉 dīng.
女 (woman) — women and family, as in 妈, 她, 姐.
子 (child) — a woman with her child: the picture of something good.
亻 (person) — people, as in 你, 他, 做; 像 is a person's likeness.
象 (xiàng, elephant) gives the exact sound; 象 first meant elephant, then "image".
言 (speech) — written 讠 on the left of other characters: a warning is spoken.
敬 (jìng, respect) is a close sound clue for jǐng.
宀 (roof) — houses and shelter, as in 家, 安, 室: to look carefully inside.
祭 (jì) is a loose sound clue for chá; 祭 also sounds out 际 jì and 擦 cā.
氵 (water) — water, as in 河, 海, 汤; 漂 is to float.
票 (piào) gives the exact sound; also in 飘 piāo.
亮 (liàng) is a sound clue for 谅 liàng and 晾 liàng; as a word it means bright, as in 月亮 moon.
刀 (knife) — cutting, as in 切, 刻, 到: a blade splits.
八 (eight) — originally two lines pulling apart: divide. 分 also gives 份 fèn, 粉 fěn and 纷 fēn.
钅 (metal, simplified 金) — metals, as in 钱, 铁, 错: a bell is cast metal.
中 (zhōng) gives the exact sound; 中 also means middle.
比 (compare) — two people side by side, one lined up with the other; to compare.
贝 (cowrie) — money and value, as in 财, 货, 买: competing for prizes was once tied to offerings and stakes.
兄 (xiōng) is only a loose sound clue for kuàng; the radical here is the ice form of 氵, as in 決.
关 (close) — simplified from 關, a gate 门 with a bolt across it; 关 also means "concern", as in 关系.
糸 (silk thread; 纟 on the left) — ties and connections, as in 红, 给, 经. 系 is a link or relation.
真 (zhēn) is a sound clue for 镇 zhèn and 慎 shèn; 真 means real, true.
马 (horse) — a galloping horse. As a radical it marks horses: 骑 ride, 驾 drive. It gives sound to 妈 mā, 吗 ma, 骂 mà and 码 mǎ.
冫 (ice) — here the ice form of 氵 (water): 决 first meant to break a dam, so a decisive break.
夬 (guài) is a loose sound clue for jué; 夬 also sounds out 快 kuài and 块 kuài.
木 (tree) — trees and wood, as in 树, 林, 本: 根 is a root.
艮 (gèn) is a close sound clue for gēn; 艮 also sounds out 跟 gēn and 很 hěn.
木 (tree) — a tree with a mark at the base: the root, hence source, origin, and the measure word for books.
于 (yú) is a sound clue for 宇 yǔ and 芋 yù; it is a light grammar word meaning "at, to".
面 (face) — a picture of a face; extended to the surface or side of things, as in 外面 outside.
广 (shelter) — buildings, as in 店 shop, 床 bed, 度 degree; 底 is the base of a house.
氐 (dī) is a close sound clue for dǐ; also in 低 dī and 抵 dǐ.
